reports.title: The Cigna Group Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results, Raises 2026 Outlook

lines: The Cigna Group’s outlook for full year 2026 consolidated adjusted income from operations1,2 is at least $30.60 per share2.

desk.headline: Revenue up 6% to $73.7bn and adjusted EPS $7.98, beat; 2026 outlook raised to at least $30.60 a share

numbers.eps_basis: adjusted (adjusted income from operations per share)

other.label: GAAP EPS
other.change: from $6.98 (prior year had a gain on sale)

other.label: Specialty and Care Services pre-tax profit

results: Revenue rose 6% to $73.7bn, with both Evernorth and Cigna Healthcare growing; adjusted EPS rose 2% to $7.98.
GAAP EPS fell to $5.47 from $6.98, mainly because last year included a gain on a business sale.
Pharmacy benefit profit fell 22% after big client contract renewals and investment, while specialty and care profit rose 15%.
Cigna Healthcare profit rose 15% to $1.19bn; the medical care ratio edged up to 85.0%.
Medical customers grew 2% this year to 18.5m; about $500m of shares bought back year to date.

guidance.summary: Cigna raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook by $0.15 to at least $30.60 and lifted its health insurance profit outlook. On the call it gave an early 2027 view of at least 10% growth from about $30 a share.

points: The CEO called 2026 and 2027 "transitional years" for the pharmacy benefit business, as rebate pools shrink and employers cover fewer weight-loss GLP-1 drugs.
The new no-rebate Signature pharmacy model starts in the fully insured book on 1 Jan 2027, with a wider rollout in 2028.
Early 2027 view: a starting point of about $30 a share, growing at least 10%; exiting the ACA exchanges costs about $200m.
Medical cost trends are "elevated but stable" and in line with pricing.
The $3bn Accelerate to One savings plan targets 2030; buybacks remain an attractive use of capital.
call.source: Earnings call transcript — The Motley Fool, 5 Nov 2026

watch: Full 2027 guidance on the Q4 call, against the early ~$30 base and 10%+ growth.
Pharmacy benefit profits through the Signature transition and client renewals.
Medical cost trend and the exit from Individual and Family Plans on 1 Jan 2027.
